findings.title: Onboarding publishes success when Precision Touchpad restart is absent or fails
findings.reproduction: Executed real PowerShell7.4.6/Linux with exact extracted worker bodies and fake registry/PnP cmdlets: onboarding exits0/publishes token0 for no devices, Disable-PnpDevice refusal and Enable-PnpDevice refusal. Same injected scenarios against actual tray restart body exit1/token1. See run-worker-probes.py and worker-output.txt. No Windows PnP or AHK execution.
findings.root_cause: Onboarding worker allows empty device enumeration, overrides Stop with explicit SilentlyContinue for both PnP operations, then unconditionally sets success0. It lacks the standalone restart worker zero-device guard, terminating errors and re-enable finally.
findings.silent_failure: Wizard reads valid success token and shows successful setup even though cached native mapping was not activated; failed re-enable can leave device unrecovered by that worker.
findings.regression_test: Execute both emitted workers with none/disable failure/enable failure/partial multi-device failures, assert truthful failure token plus re-enable attempts. Pin one shared restart implementation or behavioral equivalence.
findings.native_validation: PowerShell engine exercised on Linux with fake Windows primitives; Windows5.1/PnP untested

findings.title: Existing invalid touchpad backup authorizes destructive registry configuration
findings.reproduction: SOURCE-ONLY AHK scenario, not executed: existing backup file contains garbage (or unreadable/wrong-header/incomplete current inventory), original current registry has custom DWORD values. EnsureBackup returns true by existence; Apply overwrites all34 values. Restore rejects same backup before mutation. Unexecuted fixture case in native-repros.ahk; source-checks.cjs asserts actual paths.
findings.root_cause: TouchpadRegistryEnsureBackup uses FSStrictExists as restoration authority for an existing backup and create-race fallback, without read/parse/current inventory proof. Restore has strict validation but only after original values have been overwritten.
findings.silent_failure: Apply/onboarding can report configuration success with no readable backup capable of restoring original user values. Failure surfaces only at later Clear/Restore.
findings.regression_test: Use real owner with in-memory seams: malformed/unreadable/wrong-key/version/missing-name existing backups refuse Apply/onboarding with zero writes. Valid existing original snapshot stays immutable; concurrent create must also be validated.

findings.title: Onboarding cross-account UAC writes elevated administrator HKCU instead of original user hive
findings.reproduction: SOURCE/PLATFORM conditional scenario, native Windows test not executed: launch onboarding as standard user A, enter different administrator B credentials for RunAs. Resident process backs up A HKCU; elevated worker uses bare HKCU which resolves to B. B hive changes while A gestures stay unchanged. Compare both SID hives; negative controls same-account consent and tray Apply-before-elevate.
findings.root_cause: Entire onboarding registry+PnP worker is elevated with *RunAs but target remains HKCU and no original-user SID/explicit HKU hive is retained. Backup owner runs before elevation under original account.
findings.silent_failure: Worker can report success for wrong profile; original user sees unchanged gestures and backup/clear for A cannot undo B profile modifications.
findings.regression_test: Native two-user UAC test verifying original SID hive changes only, backup matches same identity, administrator hive unchanged; preferably write current-user registry in resident process and elevate only PnP restart as tray already does.
